generate_equation_and_solution: generate a modular arithmetic equation with brackets and its solution for a given modulus and length
generate_raw_dataset: generate a dataset of modular arithmetic equations and their solutions encoded as integer sequences
solve_equation_sample_batch: sample a batch of one-hot encoded equations and solutions from the SolveEquation task
solve_equation_init: initialize a SolveEquation task with a specified modulus for training neural networks
solve_equation_input_size: get the input size for the SolveEquation task based on the modulus plus special token classes
